headline: Boeing (BA) Reports Q2 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
summary: Boeing (BA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -123.53% and +2.11%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
